test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

GREATLY ∶ ERGAYLT ∶∶ MIXTURE ∶ XIMTERU ∶∶ TROUBLE ∶ ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **First and third alphabets are interchanged & fifth **and seventh alphabets are interchanged.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00fafcbf0277d394bf8cb35ab73784542169698485edf6d65b053d490ccd0aae.png] **
** GREATLY **is coded as ** ERGAYLT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1320dc5c24e5f9de958e97bffd2140b6d88c4c17bf1929903be32e3ab1246eb7.png] 

 **MIXTURE **is coded as** XIMTERU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/218b4e76839aced64bcfcbfd687164f47072cf4b6c36351bc4fe6f0a5d52ad63.png] 

 **TROUBLE **is coded as** ORTUELB**

Hence, the correct answer is ORTUELB.**
